description: Retrieval gold set over the California proposition corpus. Each item is a plausible citizen query with the measure(s) that should rank first. Gold is a SET: several filings are genuine duplicates of one another (same initiative filed twice, or three near-identical revenue measures), so any member ranking first is correct.

provenance.caveat: Queries and gold labels were authored by the same session that first ran them, so absolute scores are soft. Comparisons between models over the identical item set are the sound use. See README.

items.query: teaching climate and sustainability in schools
my insurance denied treatment my doctor said I need
items.notes: Colloquial phrasing; the measure's title is 'RESTRICTS INSURANCE DENIALS FOR PHYSICIAN-RECOMMENDED MEDICAL CARE'.

items.query: ethnic studies requirement to graduate from CSU
voter ID and proof of citizenship to vote
health clinics must spend most money on patient care
cap on hospital executive pay
protecting boycotts supporting Palestinian rights
make it harder for cities to raise local taxes
items.notes: Three filings share an identical title. 25-0004A1 and 25-0005A1 are BYTE-IDENTICAL in title+summary and therefore produce identical vectors — no encoder can separate them. Any of the three ranking first is correct. See #1219.

items.query: should california secede from the united states
items.notes: Same initiative filed twice under different ids.

salaries of executives running hospitals

proving you are a citizen before casting a ballot

enseñanza sobre el clima y la sostenibilidad en las escuelas
items.notes: Spanish query against an English corpus. MiniLM-L6-v2 is English-only and cannot serve these; this is the ES-parity gate the nomic decision rests on.

loan to help a middle income family buy a newly built house
items.notes: Measure creates CalHFA-administered middle-class homeownership loans for newly constructed single-family homes.

items.query: state money in an account so my child can attend a private or religious school
items.notes: Education Savings Accounts, ~$17,000/year, TK-12. The measure text is explicit that it is NOT a voucher model.

items.query: keep the tax on the top two percent that pays for schools instead of letting it expire
items.notes: Extends the 2012 high-earner income tax; measure text cites $104 billion raised since passage.

items.query: pass my house to my kids without the property tax going up
items.notes: Restores the pre-2021 parent-child and grandparent-grandchild transfer exclusion from reassessment.

items.query: let ballot measures go back on the June primary ballot
items.notes: Reclaim Voters Rights Act — restores the right lost in 2011 to vote on initiatives at statewide primaries.

items.query: my insurance company lowballed the claim I paid premiums for
items.notes: 'Insurance Policyholder Bill of Rights'. The lowballing language is in the findings; the title says only NEW REQUIREMENTS FOR HOMEOWNER INSURANCE POLICIES.

items.query: stop health care unions from bankrolling ballot measures
items.notes: Findings describe unions using the initiative process for leverage over health care providers.

items.query: cap what my lawyer can take out of a car crash settlement
items.notes: Requires the victim retain at least 75% of the total recovered.

items.query: speed up environmental review so housing and clean energy get built
items.notes: Building an Affordable California Act — CEQA changes for 'essential projects'.

items.query: rules protecting children from AI chatbots and phones at school
items.notes: GOLD SET: two near-identical AI child-safety filings. Either ranking first is correct.

items.query: borrow money to fund research into curing immune diseases
items.notes: California Immunology Research and Cures Initiative — bond authorization.

items.query: hold Uber responsible when a passenger is injured
items.notes: Rideshare Company Public Accountability Act. Distinguish from 25-0029A1, which is the sexual-misconduct measure.

items.query: rideshare companies accountable for sexual assault of passengers and drivers
items.notes: Paired with ret-en-026: the two rideshare measures must be distinguishable from each other.

items.query: what happens if a president refuses to leave office when his term ends
items.notes: 'King Slayer Act: Defense of Constitutional Order'.

items.query: crack down on charities that funnel money to for-profit companies
items.notes: California Charitable Fraud Prevention Act; parens patriae findings. The title says only REGULATES CERTAIN NONPROFIT RESEARCH ORGANIZATIONS.

items.query: stop charging property tax on the homes of people over sixty
items.notes: Exempts the principal residence of eligible homeowners from ad valorem property tax from the 2027-28 lien date.

items.query: how long can I stay in California before I owe state income tax
items.notes: Splits taxpayers into part-time resident, resident and non-resident by physical presence. The residency test is in the text, not the title.

items.query: audit a new special tax program before voters get to approve it
items.notes: Pre-election financial and performance audit by the State Auditor.

items.query: stop taxing prepared food at the grocery store
items.notes: UNLOCK CANDIDATE: the corpus entry is the bare act name 'California Food Tax Fairness Act'. The prepared-food distinction exists only in fullText, so this should miss until #1261 lands a real summary.

items.query: bonds to build housing for veterans
items.notes: Veterans and Affordable Housing Bond Act of 2026.

items.query: public money for campaigns so candidates need not chase wealthy donors
items.notes: California Fair Elections Act findings. The corpus entry is the bare bill title.

items.notes: Spanish query against an English-only measure.

items.query: requisitos de identificación para poder votar
items.notes: California Voter ID Initiative.
